{{Top|leg}}
'''Honor-wife''' was the name used to describe one of the secondary wives of a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Because the ratio of Cerean women to men was twenty to one, males took several honor-wives in addition to their [[bond-wife]]. Relationships between bond-wives and honor-wives were often strained, especially regarding the topic of children.
